data.narrative:
Arbe Robotics is a public-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $118M to date. The valuation universe for Drones & Autonomous comprises eight private peers, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Waymo, Wayve, and Zipline, with zero public comparables in the narrow peer set. This sparse public market limits direct comparable company benchmarking.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The sector contains only two same-stage peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero similar-valuation-tier peers—falling short of the minimum three datapoints required for reliable triangulation. An all-sector median approach would obscure meaningful stage and scale differences within Drones & Autonomous, rendering it misleading rather than informative.

Given the absence of sufficient narrow peer data and zero public trading comps, traditional comparable company analysis cannot be conclusively applied. Valuation of Arbe Robotics would require alternative methods—such as precedent transactions within autonomous vehicle or drone infrastructure, DCF modeling based on revenue visibility, or venture capital method analysis tied to milestone-based probability adjustments. Key uncertainties include the timing and profitability trajectory of autonomous systems commercialization, regulatory approval pathways, and competitive positioning relative to larger, well-capitalized peers like Waymo. Further data collection on recent funding rounds or M&A activity in the sector would strengthen valuation support.
